claim_boundary: This document is an open preregistration/audit ledger. It authorizes no product PASS and no Knight execution.

verified_findings.finding: Fixed tile_resolution=8 was selected from atlas capacity, not source-frequency or projected-texel-density preservation.
verified_findings.required_closure: Subject-free projected footprint / high-frequency line-art survival calibration; select fixed/adaptive tile policy from art-quality evidence.

verified_findings.finding: COMPILED_NEAREST_SURFACE and COMPILED_GLOBAL_SURFACE are cKDTree nearest-sample color propagation, not structure-aware inpainting.
verified_findings.required_closure: Replace shipping completion with source-constrained surface completion for bounded gaps; forbid visible global fill; fail/abstain on unsupported large regions.

verified_findings.finding: The same canonical surface locus can be directly observed in multiple views without an explicit cross-view appearance compatibility authority.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add adjacent-view/component alpha contradiction and source-conditioned premultiplied color/edge compatibility evidence without requiring naive RGB equality.

verified_findings.finding: Historical Stage45 exempted micro-visible faces and consequential-but-unmeasurable faces from the shipping condition and aggregated inferred exposure globally.
verified_findings.required_closure: Hard-gate unmeasurable consequential faces, micro-face pixel load, frame-max exposure, largest connected inferred patch and visible global-fill exposure.

verified_findings.finding: Native CAA runtime uses premultiplied bilinear sampling only; no mip/minification or anisotropic sampling authority exists.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add subject-free screen-space minification/shimmer controls and a qualified filtering/LOD contract shared by reference and native runtimes.

verified_findings.finding: CAA is baked on Stage18 candidate identity while final Stage35 QualifiedMesh only carried the candidate hash transitively; Stage37/38 lacked explicit equality enforcement.
PRESERVE_CONTINUITY historically required only global connected-component membership and did not prove local boundary adjacency.
verified_findings.repair: Qualified-mesh intrinsic audit now requires a shared-support vertex or direct mesh edge across each PRESERVE_CONTINUITY pair.

verified_findings.finding: Rigid/deformable classification was computed once per mechanical component, so appearance-separated presentation groups inherited one class and rigid props inside deformable components could silently wobble.
verified_findings.repair: Mechanical classification is now evaluated per presentation face group.

verified_findings.finding: V2 exact-depth ties are resolved by sealed face index and no near-depth ambiguity/z-fighting gate exists. Determinism therefore does not guarantee artist-authoritative layer order or temporal stability.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add exact/near-depth overlap ambiguity evidence and either fail ambiguous physical-depth states or mint an explicit qualified presentation tie authority with a narrowly scoped contract.
verified_findings.repair: Reference visibility now exposes runner-up depth/owner and exact-depth ambiguity. Rest and Stage45 hard-fail exact coplanar overlap while face-index-only tie semantics remain active.

verified_findings.finding: No explicit adjacent-direction appearance continuity or direction-switch flicker authority exists for the eight separately baked CAA textures.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add source-conditioned adjacent-direction compatibility plus transition/shimmer controls; do not demand raw RGB equality where view-dependent artist intent is supported.

verified_findings.finding: The 256-cube decoder numerical floor is demonstrated primarily on smooth sphere/ellipsoid controls; minimum thin-feature/concavity/gap survival through decoder->raster is not explicitly calibrated.
verified_findings.required_closure: Run a 1024px subject-free feature-survival panel (thin plates/straps, narrow gaps/forks, concave notches, brims/blades, small components) and derive decoder/adaptive-resolution policy from measured survival.

verified_findings.finding: Hash invalidation forces downstream remeasurement after an upstream repair, but no explicit dual-domain non-regression rule prevents a rest improvement from consuming dynamic quality margin or vice versa.
verified_findings.required_closure: Require every geometry/appearance repair candidate to pass both static and dynamic adversarial banks before promotion, with protected-metric non-regression evidence.

verified_findings.finding: Rigid thresholds 0.999/0.001 can silently classify evidence-supported rigid groups as DEFORMABLE; there is no calibrated rigid-detection coverage/no-op proof.
verified_findings.required_closure: Calibrate group-level rigid/deformable decisions on subject-free hard-rigid and smooth-skin controls and expose evidence-supported rigid misses as failures.

verified_findings.finding: Current dynamic appearance calibration contains affine stretch controls but no articulated LBS shoulder/elbow/hip bend cases; absolute UV-to-surface condition ceiling 32 is outside the selected relative candidate ladder.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add subject-free articulated LBS benign/adversarial controls and calibrate every shipping conditioning ceiling from that bank before refreeze.

verified_findings.finding: Stage45 historically measures only pixels already owned by geometry. A motion-opened background gap between articulated/open-surface parts has owner=-1 and can therefore disappear from the DVI denominator instead of being counted as a hole. Current V2 has no current-authority continuity-underlay or equivalent dynamic coverage proof.
verified_findings.required_closure: Introduce a current V2 dynamic continuity/underlay or equivalent coverage authority for articulated boundaries and open surfaces; prove rest+motion jointly so a rest repair cannot create dynamic gaps.

verified_findings.finding: A future mip/minification repair cannot reuse the current two-pixel per-tile bleed blindly; ordinary atlas mip generation can mix neighboring face tiles across mip levels even when base-level bilinear bleed is correct.
verified_findings.required_closure: Qualify mip-safe island padding or per-island/per-face mip generation together with the minification filter contract.

verified_findings.finding: Stage41 bounds triangle area ratio and local condition but has no explicit non-adjacent dynamic self-intersection/interpenetration qualification. A mesh can remain locally well-conditioned while distinct body/clothing regions pass through each other and corrupt visibility.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add subject-free dynamic self-intersection evidence with adjacency exclusions and rest-existing-contact handling; gate newly introduced consequential intersections or explicitly narrow the product claim.

verified_findings.finding: Current contact mode set contains only PLANT_2D and Stage41 correctly measures XY drift. This is not a contract bug, but it cannot establish full foot-ground height/penetration or 3D pinned-contact quality despite broad all_contacts_satisfied wording.
verified_findings.required_closure: Narrow the claim to PLANT_2D or add calibrated PLANT_3D / ground-plane contact semantics with vertical height and penetration evidence before professional-contact quality is claimed.

verified_findings.finding: Native V2 proof renders only exact sealed Stage41 frame indices. No current evidence was found that native proof interpolates unproved frames; however host-side continuous interpolation semantics are not explicit in the V2 package authority.
verified_findings.required_closure: Declare playback sampling semantics explicitly. If hosts interpolate, prove the interpolation envelope; otherwise require exact sealed-frame playback semantics.

false_or_overstated_external_findings.claim: G5 calibration PASS hides current_mesh_semantic_separation_pass=false as an active failed shipping metric.
false_or_overstated_external_findings.reason: Those booleans belong to a retrospective corruption-separation audit showing older/current thresholds failed to separate controls; the selected P999 profile is the promoted policy. The remaining valid concern is insufficient feature-rich numerical-floor calibration.

false_or_overstated_external_findings.claim: 256-cube implies exactly four source pixels per voxel at 1024.
false_or_overstated_external_findings.reason: Projected pixel scale depends on normalized bounds, object occupancy and camera framing. A fixed 256 decoder can still impose a feature ceiling, but it must be measured rather than inferred as a universal 4px/voxel ratio.

requirements: Every HIGH finding CLOSED with executable subject-free evidence.
Every repaired invariant has an adversarial regression test.
Static and dynamic fidelity banks both PASS on the same exact implementation closure.
No threshold is selected or relaxed from Knight.
Fresh stage-by-stage red-team finds no unscoped product-quality false-PASS.
Assistant and user explicitly approve before Knight.
